Grouping is equivalent: docker_image maps to the observed container_image_name label, which exists in the dataset.
The metric is a monotonic sum of bytes with the write operation selected, so rate() over $__rate_interval is allowed and the quantity (bytes written) matches.
The scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.

Outcome translated is correct because no function is used and the mapping exists; only the aggregation is wrong, so the candidate should use avg (for example avg by (container_image_name) of the per-container rate, averaged over the series that feed that group) and not sum.
